findings.summary: The node's required artifact audits/methodology-compliance.md was never produced. The node's entire role is to emit this final evidenced compliance audit (why: 'produce evidence that the claims in this graph actually hold'); no file anywhere in the repo references 'methodology-compliance', and the deterministic result records artifacts_present={'audits/methodology-compliance.md': False} with all three acceptance criteria indeterminate. The node's core deliverable is absent.

Execution violated the explicit ordering constraint 'Runs only after review-product-coherence corrects the product.' Dependency review-product-coherence is still provisional (deps_status), its required artifact reviews/product-coherence.md does not exist, yet this audit job ran (3 attempts). The audit therefore measured — or would have measured — a product the reviewer never reviewed, breaking the invariant the node exists to protect ('never audits a product the reviewer just flagged').

The only repository change across all attempts was a 6-line citation-number edit to audits/design-review.md (audits/design-review.md:123-224 region) — that file is the design-review node's artifact, not this node's. Attempt 0 and attempt 2 were empty commits; the job produced no work product attributable to audit-methodology-compliance and edited another node's scope instead of delivering its own.

integrity.reasoning: Fresh-eyes review of node audit-methodology-compliance. The node is the graph's final gate: re-run the methodology/criteria against the finished, reviewed-and-corrected product and emit audits/methodology-compliance.md with cited evidence, gated on review-product-coherence having completed first. None of that happened. (1) The required artifact does not exist anywhere in the working tree; the deterministic result confirms it, and all three acceptance criteria are indeterminate — the node's deliverable, which downstream trust in the whole graph depends on, is missing. (2) The run fired while review-product-coherence is still provisional and its artifact reviews/product-coherence.md is absent, directly contradicting the node's own constraint and why — the final audit ran out of order, so the graph's core invariant ('claims are only true when evidenced against the finished state') was not protected. (3) The only substantive change in the entire job (eff0c06, 6 ins/6 del) touched audits/design-review.md — the design-review node's artifact — fixing stale line citations; useful hygiene, but out of scope for this node and not a substitute for the compliance audit. Lane 1 separately judges the criteria; from an integrity standpoint the intent is not recognizable in the work product and the execution ordering was broken. The graph's own config marks this node 'ready' while its unlocker is provisional, which is how the premature run happened; the mirror/auto-advance should not advance a final gate whose prerequisite milestone is unaccepted. Human review is required before this node can be considered done or re-run.

semantic.overall_reasoning: The node audit-methodology-compliance required one deliverable — audits/methodology-compliance.md, the final audit mapping every design-review/audit claim to cited evidence, re-running the per-surface methodology audit with severities and routing, and honestly recording pass/fail. That artifact does not exist: the audits/ directory contains only design-review.md; the HEAD commit tree (a7226d2) contains no reviews/ directory and no methodology-compliance file; git history across all branches shows the file was never created; and the job's three attempts produced nothing (attempt 0 empty, attempt 1 only edited audits/design-review.md's line citations, attempt 2 empty, subject diff empty). Additionally, the node ran before its precondition held: dependency review-product-coherence is still provisional, its required artifact reviews/product-coherence.md is absent from the working chain (only on unmerged gddp/attempt branches), and the upstream tui-methodology-audit artifact is likewise missing from the chain — the design-review document itself records this absence (audits/design-review.md:12-36, 335-360). All three acceptance criteria fail because the document that is their subject was never produced, and the graph's 'audit only after review corrects the product' invariant was not met in this chain.
semantic.risks: 1. Graph sequencing: audit-methodology-compliance was dispatched (frontier_auto_advance) while review-product-coherence is still provisional and its artifact reviews/product-coherence.md is not an ancestor of the working chain (exists only on unmerged branches gddp/attempt-job_20260825T00133251a3dabef1599b-*). Same for audits/tui-methodology.md (branch gddp/attempt-job_20260824T23454410e9729b7016aa-*). The 'Runs only after review-product-coherence corrects the product' constraint was therefore not satisfiable in this chain; this may be a harness dispatch issue rather than an executor defect, but it means the audit had no corrected product and no prior audit documents to re-check. 2. The node's only observable action was modifying another node's artifact: attempt 1 (eff0c06) edited audits/design-review.md line references — arguably out of scope for an audit-only node and a potential graph-integrity concern, though the edits appear to correct stale citations rather than change substance. 3. No evidence trail for this job exists: the .gddp/ decision.md and result-summary.md in the worktree are stale pilot-graph content (common-core), not this node's record.

Was that within scope for this audit-only node, or should it be treated as a graph-integrity violation (per the design-review doc's own 'integrity guards' that forbid touching other nodes' artifacts)? 3. Observed: the tui-methodology audit and coherence-review artifacts exist on unmerged gddp/attempt branches (1422fd7, 69bd65b) but were never merged into the main chain. Should those be carried forward so the final audit has its stated inputs, or is the chain state itself in need of correction?
